_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 5, GIVING WATER TO WORKERS (Frame.io GIVNG WATER TO WORKERS). Variation 1 of 4: ONE worker, wordless, Erez-v1 grammar (wide -> 4-frame snap zoom -> tight hold -> hard cut), slow-mo on the handoff, the drink, the hug and the smile after the kiss. Tal: 'give him the water -> slow-motion shot drinking -> reaction -> end'. Source: IMG_8613, Tel Aviv promenade at golden hour, Tal and the street cleaner. Picture-led: grade off (phone footage that already looks right, LESSONS 72), no captions (nothing intelligible is said - transcript is one hallucinated 'you'), soundtrack = this clip's own street ambience as one continuous bed (bedOnly), so 12 picture cuts do not make 12 audio splices. Passers-by avoided: a cyclist behind the cleaner 1.9-2.5s and a shirtless runner crossing the lens ~4.5-4.7s (checked on frames) are both outside every beat.
beats: WIDE: the cleaner pushing his cart, Tal steps in holding the bottle out - the giver and the gift in the first frame
4-frame snap zoom onto the handoff (both faces + hands)
SLOW-MO: he takes the water with both hands, smiling at Tal
tight hold, real time: the bottle in his hands (ends before the runner crosses at ~4.5)
CUT + snap zoom onto his face - he is already drinking
SLOW-MO close-up: he drinks (the payoff Tal asked for)
CUT: he holds the bottle out to Tal, both hands on it - the two of them connecting (a woman walks behind at ~6.5-7.8, kept out)
snap zoom as Tal pulls him in (a jogger passes behind at ~10.4 at the left edge, outside this crop - checked on the render)
the hug holds, real time; he reaches up to kiss Tal's cheek
SLOW-MO, LAST SHOT: the kiss on the cheek and his biggest smile of the clip (12.7-13.0) - ends on the smile
